confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on several aggregator sources with unclear data dates, so they are reasonably consistent. Beer is a mix of city and national figures. Cocktail is derived from the local beer price, not a direct observation, and wine is a national bottle price converted to a by-the-glass estimate. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. The FX figure comes from an RBA homepage/overview snippet and was not verified against the F11 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Taichung is a mid-sized Taiwanese city, so prices are anchored to Taiwan-wide and Taipei cost-of-living figures, adjusted downward for Taichung's lower prices. Accommodation is based on general knowledge of the mid-sized Taiwanese hotel and hostel market.
